name: Martin Šuba
title: Engineering Manager
about: Engineering Manager with a strong background in web product development across JavaScript / TypeScript, React, and Node.js. Combines hands-on engineering experience with team leadership, technical ownership, and close product collaboration. Strongest in leading product engineering teams in web-based environments, shaping technical solutions, improving execution, and delivering user-facing products in changing environments.

experience.title: Engineering Manager
experience.description: Leading the Solution Implementation team responsible for configuring, releasing, and delivering cybersecurity solutions to partners, while overseeing internal automation and delivery tooling development. In this role, I focus on improving delivery tooling, automating internal processes, and developing internal tools that improve workflows, reduce manual effort, and make delivery more efficient and reliable, including AI-orchestrated workflows and agentic automations. Current automation initiatives are reducing manual effort by up to 80% in selected internal workflows.

experience.title: Technical Project Lead
experience.description: In addition to my Engineering Manager responsibilities, took on a side role as Technical Project Lead, managing Tier-1 partner deliveries end-to-end, coordinating cross-team execution, and improving delivery processes in a dynamic environment. Worked across engineering and stakeholder groups to keep delivery aligned, unblock execution, and drive complex customer-facing releases.

experience.title: Lead Frontend engineer
experience.description: Led frontend development of password manager clients, including browser extensions and SDKs for TypeScript, iOS, and Android. Worked closely with Product and engineering stakeholders on integrating SaferPass technology into F-Secure products and apps, discussing technical feasibility, feature integration, and UX coherence to ensure the combined experience made sense for users. Led the technical solution for delivering SaferPass technology as a component in the F-Secure SDK, including integration across web and native technologies. Owned architectural direction in this area, coordinated cross-team execution, and helped deliver a successful SDK release for a Tier-1 customer, enabling launch of a new product offering.

experience.title: Lead Frontend engineer at SaferPass (acquired by F-Secure)
experience.description: Started taking on team lead responsibilities while continuing hands-on frontend development of the SaferPass web product and browser extension. Worked across product and engineering during the acquisition period, helping maintain delivery continuity, support the team through change, and contribute to the transition of the product into a larger organization.

experience.title: JavaScript Developer (acquired by Lookout)
experience.description: Worked as a JavaScript developer in a small, product-focused startup environment, building the frontend of the SaferPass web-based password manager and browser extension. Worked across JavaScript / TypeScript, AngularJS, React, Web Extension APIs, Web APIs, and Node.js to deliver new features, refactor legacy code, and improve test coverage.
